### 🚗 CarSplit — Apple CarPlay Dual-Screen

Run any two apps side-by-side on your Apple CarPlay display simultaneously!

> ⚠️ **Important Prerequisite:** CarSplit requires **CarBridge** (official release available at [carbridge.app](https://carbridge.app) and [Havoc Repo](https://havoc.app/package/carbridge)) installed on your device to mirror and bridge applications onto the CarPlay display.

#### 📱 Tested & Verified Hardware
- **Device:** iPhone 7 (`iPhone9,3`)
- **Firmware:** iOS 15.8.8 (Dopamine 2 Rootless)
- **CarPlay Head Unit:** 100% verified in actual vehicle.
- *Other iOS 15.x / 16.x devices supported in Community Beta.*

#### ✨ Key Features
- 🏎️ **True Dual-App Multitasking:** Both apps remain fully active with zero pauses.
- 🗺️ **Any App Combination:** Maps + YouTube, AI Assistant + Media, Yandex + Navigation, etc.
- 👆 **Independent Touch Controls:** Full dual touch-screen input on both halves.
- ⏱️ **One-Tap Clock Switch:** Tap CarPlay status bar clock to cycle layouts.
- ⚙️ **Settings App Integration:** Custom toggle (Enabled by default upon install).
- 🌍 **11 Language Localizations:** Full native translation (including Vietnamese).
- 🛡️ **100% Free Community Release:** Strictly not for sale.

> *Tested and confirmed working in real vehicle.*
